questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘Conscientous’ is ‘Conscientious’which means “wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly” मेहनती, ईमानदार

questions.question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the following sentence.
I am contant with my day’s work.
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘contant’ is ‘content’which means “in a state of peaceful happiness” संतुष्ट, सुखी.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of ‘Advertisment’ is ‘Advertisement’which means “a public notice or announcement, especially one promoting a product, service, or event” विज्ञापन.

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.
The west Africans have a heritage of produsing sculpture using wax and bronze
questions.solution: C) The correct spelling of ‘Produsing’ is ‘Producing’which means “making or manufacturing from components or raw materials” निर्माण करना, उत्पादन करना.

questions.question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.
The boy found the project to be a peice of cake because it was incredibly easy
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of ‘peice’ is ‘piece’which means “a portion of an object or of material, produced by cutting, tearing, or breaking the whole” टुकड़ा.

questions.question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.
The calandar was reformed during the time of Julius Caesar
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘calandar’ is ‘calendar’which means "a system for fixing the beginning, length, and divisions of the civil year and arranging days and longer divisions of time in a definite order" (पंचांग, दिनदर्शिका).

questions.question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
The mighty gaint brought a marigold for the princess.
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of ‘Gaint’ is ‘Giant’which means “an imaginary or mythical being of human form but superhuman size.” विशालकाय, दानवाकार.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: B) The correct spelling of 'Couragious' is'Courageous'which means "having or characterized by courage; brave" साहसी, वीर.

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.
Shreya prefers wearing green coloured saree on marriage funcktions.
questions.solution: B) The correct spelling of ‘Funcktions’ is ‘Functions’which means “an activity or purpose natural to or intended for a person or thing” कार्य, उद्देश्य.

questions.question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.
You shall recieve proper pay for your work.
questions.solution: B) The incorrectly spelt word in the sentence is "recieve." The correct spelling is "receive," which means “to get or be given something” प्राप्त करना, स्वीकार करना.

questions.question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word.
He is one of the most underated players in the team.
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘underated’ is ‘underrated’which means “not rated or valued highly enough” कम आंका गया, कम मूल्यांकित.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: C)The correct spelling of ‘Innoculate’ is ‘Inoculate’which means ‘to protect a person or animal from a disease by giving him/her/it a mild form of the disease with a needle which is put under the skin (an injection)’ टीका लगाना

questions.question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.
It is his previlage to present all the candidates for ordination to the bishop of the diocese
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of ‘previlage’ is ‘privilege’which means “a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group”विशेषअधिकार.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: C)Theincorrectlyspelt word is ‘Mantain’. The correct spelling is ‘Maintain’ which means “cause or enable (a condition or state of affairs) to continue.” बनाए रखना, स्थिर रखना.

questions.question:
Identify the correct spelling of the underlined word.
The police issued a varant to the criminals
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of ‘varant’ is 'warrant' which means “a legal document authorizing the police to make an arrest, search premises, or carry out some other action”वॉरंट,आदेश

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: B)The incorrectly spelt word is "Scatered." The correct spelling should be "Scattered," which means “spread or thrown over a wide area” बिखरा हुआ, छितराया हुआ।

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of ‘Comendation’ is ‘Commendation’which means “an expression of praise or approval” प्रशंसा.

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.
They were good-hearted girls, unclean, clothed in rags and profiundly ignorant
questions.solution: A)The correct spelling of 'Profiundly' is'Profoundly'which means "to a profound extent; extremely" अत्यंत, गहन.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of'Apropriate'is'Appropriate'which means"suitable or proper in the circumstances"उचित.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: D) The incorrectly spelt word is "Agressive." The correct spelling should be "Aggressive," which means “ready or likely to attack or confront; characterized by or resulting from aggression” आक्रामक, लड़ाकू।
